title: Mixed Duo #025 · 여 에이펙스 사이렌·CarnivalGlam / 남 머슬 모델·골드 글리터
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a cherry-blossom avenue in full bloom with a pale paved path strewn with petals, a waist-high wooden fence, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Brazilian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold bracelets. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; not thin, not boyish, not evenly proportioned; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Italian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, smooth light-olive skin, a cool composed look, pure icy-white hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold small flared temple bell, a tin ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver necklaces. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
